summary: IDF airstrike in Khan Younis targeted a tunnel shaft after three Palestinian operatives emerged, triggering secondary explosions indicating stored weaponry. Hezbollah has reportedly spent three months rearming with Iranian funding, producing attack drones and rebuilding command structures. Jordanian Air Force conducted strikes on terrorist hideouts in southern Syria linked to the Karak Church attack, prompting Syria to close the Nassib border crossing.
key_points: IDF airstrike in Khan Younis eliminated three Palestinian operatives emerging from a tunnel shaft, with secondary explosions confirming weaponry presence. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)
Israeli strikes across Gaza killed four Hamas and PIJ operatives, including a Nukhba commander and a sniper, accused of systematically violating the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59436)
IDF uncovered a 15-meter deep, 75-cm wide tunnel in Hebron near a gunman's home, displacing 2,000 residents and detaining 50 suspects during scans of 500 buildings. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)
Hezbollah has rearmed over three months using tens of millions of Iranian dollars to produce attack drones, acquire explosives, and rebuild command structures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)
Jordanian Air Force struck terrorist hideouts in southern Syria linked to the Karak Church attack; Syria suspended all traffic at the Nassib crossing with Jordan. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8933)
UKMTO reports a vessel on fire 63 nautical miles southeast of Al-Faw, Iraq; crew status and environmental impact remain unknown. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8927)

Iranian military aircraft activity includes a Hercules at Mehrabad, jet operations over Dezful and Urmia, and a UAV over Isfahan province. (Source: @shin_persian/11584, @shin_persian/11591, @shin_persian/11587, @shin_persian/11585)
Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman visited Iran to negotiate a Houthi ceasefire, reportedly offering a $1 billion transfer via Tehran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8928)

points: An IRIAF C-130 Hercules was observed on the runway at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran, prepared for takeoff, suggesting active transport or deployment operations. (Source: @shin_persian/11584)
Jet fighter activity was detected over Dezful in Khuzestan province, indicating possible training or readiness patrols in southwestern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11591)
A freighter aircraft landed at Mehrabad Airport at 0603Z (09:33 local time), pointing to ongoing logistical air movements into the capital. (Source: @shin_persian/11590)
Jet activity was recorded over Urmia in West Azerbaijan province at 07:34 local time, near the Turkish and Iraqi borders. (Source: @shin_persian/11587)
A UAV was observed over Baharestan heading toward Sepahan Shahr in Isfahan province, suggesting surveillance or test flights near central Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11585)
Iran's security chief met with Mojtaba Khamenei, the supreme leader's son, per state media, signaling high-level internal security coordination. (Source: @N12chat/231948)
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, reflecting deepening strategic alignment amid regional tensions. (Source: @N12chat/231959)

The UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry accused Israel of war crimes and crimes against humanity in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including extermination, persecution, torture, rape, and genocide in Gaza. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8930)

Trump administration allies privately discussed a Netanyahu–Eisenkot unity government with Israeli officials, with Netanyahu offering to drop far-right partners in exchange for U.S. support for renewed operations against Iran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8929)
Two people were seriously and moderately wounded in a shooting in Tayibe; police stated no apparent link to the national elections. (Source: @N12chat/231957)

An armed suspect with a knife approached opposition leader Yair Golan in Tel Aviv; security guards subdued him and police arrested the individual. (Source: @amitsegal/66264, @yediotnews25/136845, @N12chat/231952)

National voter turnout reached 31.5% by 12:00, the highest since 1973, with nearly 2.4 million ballots cast; IDF soldier turnout was 30% at 10:00, up from 25.7% in 2022. (Source: @yediotnews25/136843, @manniefabian/59438)
The Central Elections Committee reported significantly fewer irregularities compared to previous elections at this hour. (Source: @amitsegal/66238)

IDF aircraft struck a tunnel shaft in western Khan Younis after troops identified three Hamas operatives emerging; secondary explosions confirmed weaponry inside the tunnel. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

Israeli strikes across Gaza on Sunday killed PIJ operatives Alaa Abu Zaid and Hamdan Suleiman Ibrahim Abu Amra, and Hamas sniper Fawzi Salam Odat Allah Sawarha; a Saturday strike killed Hamas Nukhba commander Mohammed Anan Mohammed al-Rawagh. (Source: @manniefabian/59436)
IDF destroyed a military structure in northern Gaza used as a sniper position targeting forces, striking immediately after identification. (Source: @manniefabian/59436)

In Hebron, IDF discovered an underground passageway 15 meters deep and 75 cm wide adjacent to a gunman's home, with no exit; an electronic device inside was seized for analysis. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)
The Hebron operation scanned over 500 buildings, displaced over 2,000 Palestinian residents, apprehended 50 suspects, and seized two firearms. (Source: @manniefabian/59433)

Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Salouqi and Wadi al-Hajir, with live fire also noted in Zoutar al-Sharqiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/50171, @redlinkleb/50172, @redlinkleb/50177, @redlinkleb/50173)
A vehicle fire at the entrance to Hasbaya was reported with no security incident indicated. (Source: @redlinkleb/50134)
Four controlled detonations of explosive remnants occurred in Tir Dibba between 12:20 and 14:00. (Source: @redlinkleb/50190)
The Lebanese Army planned to detonate war remnants in the town of Haboush. (Source: @redlinkleb/50180)
Warplanes were observed over southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/50133)
Hezbollah has invested tens of millions of Iranian dollars over three months to rearm, produce attack drones, acquire explosives, and rebuild command structures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)
UKMTO received third-party reports of a vessel on fire approximately 63 nautical miles southeast of Al-Faw, Iraq; crew status and environmental impact unknown. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8927)
Syria suspended all passenger and commercial traffic across the Nassib border crossing with Jordan in both directions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8933)
The Jordanian Air Force conducted an operation targeting terrorist hideouts in southern Syria linked to the Karak Church attack. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8933)
Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman visited Iran to negotiate a Houthi ceasefire, reportedly involving a $1 billion transfer to the Houthis through Tehran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8928)
The Netherlands announced it will not participate in Eurovision due to Israel's participation. (Source: @yediotnews25/136834)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation in Gaza tunnel warfare, Hezbollah's accelerated rearmament, and Jordan's cross-border strike into Syria indicates a multi-axis pressure campaign against Iranian-backed networks. Israel's targeted killings of mid-level Hamas and PIJ commanders aim to disrupt ceasefire violation capabilities, while the Hezbollah buildup suggests preparation for a northern front escalation. Jordan's unprecedented airstrike in Syria signals a shift toward proactive counterterrorism, potentially drawing Amman deeper into the southern Syrian security vacuum. Iranian military aviation activity across multiple provinces reflects heightened readiness or internal logistics, possibly linked to regional proxy coordination.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's direct engagement with Iran over Houthi ceasefire terms, including a reported $1 billion incentive, demonstrates Riyadh's urgency to de-escalate the Red Sea threat. The UN Commission of Inquiry's formal accusation of Israeli genocide and crimes against humanity will likely amplify diplomatic isolation efforts, though Western responses remain muted. The Netherlands' Eurovision boycott reflects growing European civil society pressure. Syria's closure of the Nassib crossing after Jordan's strike highlights Damascus's limited sovereignty and reliance on Iranian-backed militias for border security.
sections.intelligence_notes: The discovery of a sophisticated tunnel in Hebron — 15 meters deep with electronic devices — suggests Hamas is expanding subterranean infrastructure deep inside the West Bank, not just near settlement blocs. The IDF's 500-building scan and mass displacement indicate a shift toward area-denial operations in Palestinian urban centers. Iranian aircraft movements at Mehrabad, Dezful, Urmia, and Isfahan within hours suggest a coordinated logistics or readiness exercise, possibly supporting proxy resupply. The vessel incident near Al-Faw warrants monitoring for potential mine or drone attack in a critical oil transit corridor.
